title: Frequency Relation
description: Essential Criteria: The relation of f'/f to theta must be correctly derived as tan(theta) = f'/f.

title: Total Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The total energy of the electron must be expressed correctly in terms of f, f', and m.

title: Speed Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The speed of the scattered electron must be calculated correctly as v = 0.53 c.

title: Energy Expression for Observer
description: Important Criteria: The expression for the observer's measure of the electron's energy must be correctly formulated in terms of m, v, u, and c.

title: Energy Conservation Application
description: Important Criteria: The application of energy conservation principles must be correctly utilized in part (c).

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include sign mistakes in the energy conservation equation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
